entries.label: A small town
entries.candidates_reason: Four seed candidates bound a request. A candidate is refused when no walkable footway spot keeps the town arrival policy clearance from street furniture, trees and resident starts; another candidate may offer a clear spot.
entries.reason: Measured: two 128 m tiles of city grammar version 5 with cross streets 90 m apart, buildings of two to four storeys, one high street, local cross streets and every share even, the smallest town whose streets hold traffic. Its served arrival is a non-seat standing spot selected by composer version 2 under the pinned town-arrival policy.
